light.name: Light
light.family: A simple status only, like "normal pattern" or "not enough data". No times, no details.
light.parent: Your family sees only a simple status. No times, no details.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.family: The status plus timing summaries, like when the day started.
rhythm.parent: Your family also sees timings, like when your day started.

glimpse.name: Glimpse
glimpse.family: Timings plus short descriptions of sensor events, like "Kitchen: movement". Never cameras or recordings.
glimpse.parent: Your family also sees short notes like "Kitchen: movement". Never cameras or recordings.

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.family: For a few days after an illness or hospital stay: also the extras the parent chose. Ends by itself.
recovery.parent: For a few days after an illness or a hospital stay, also share the extras you choose. It goes back by itself.

dashboard.title: How {{name}} is doing
dashboard.simulatedBanner: Demo data: these sensor events are simulated.
dashboard.baselineReady: Compared with {{days}} days of {{name}}'s usual routine.
dashboard.baselineBuilding: Still learning the routine: {{days}} of {{needed}} days recorded.
dashboard.nightRestUnknown: Not enough data for last night yet.
dashboard.medsTaken: {{taken}} of {{total}} medicine doses checked off today
dashboard.loadError: Hearth could not load. Try again in a moment.

contact.title: Reach {{name}}
contact.noPhone: Add a phone number on the Loved one page to call from here.
contact.emergency: Hearth is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

proposals.title: Waiting for a decision
proposals.empty: Nothing is waiting. Hearth only proposes; nothing changes until someone approves.
proposals.approved: Approved. It has been added for {{name}}.
proposals.expired: This proposal expired, so nothing was changed.
proposals.notAllowed: Only the person it is for, or an admin, can decide this.

visits.title: Upcoming visits
visits.dialogHelp: This creates a proposal. It goes on the calendar, and {{name}} sees it, only after the visitor confirms.

tasks.title: Family responsibilities
tasks.askTitle: Ask someone to take this on
tasks.askHelp: They will be asked to confirm before it is assigned.
tasks.asked: Request sent. It is assigned once they confirm.

moments.title: Family moments
moments.empty: No moments yet. A short message or video brightens the day.
moments.videoTooBig: That video is over 4 MB. Try a shorter clip.
moments.videoType: Only mp4 or webm videos can be shared.
moments.sent: Sent. It appears on {{name}}'s Hearth screen.
moments.tvUnavailable: TV delivery is not available: moments appear on the Hearth screen.

trust.title: Sharing and trust
trust.intro: {{name}} decides what the family sees. Hearth enforces that choice on the server, for the app and for Alexa+.
trust.onlyParent: Only {{name}} (from their Hearth screen) or the delegate they chose can change this.
trust.youAreDelegate: {{name}} chose you as their delegate: you can change this on their behalf.
trust.ledgerIntro: Every time someone sees {{name}}'s information, a sharing setting changes, or a proposal is decided, it is written here.

alexa.title: Alexa+
alexa.intro: Connect Alexa+ through Hearth's MCP server. Alexa answers with exactly what {{name}} shares, and asks you before approving anything.
alexa.tokenOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown only once.
alexa.notLive: Tested with the official MCP client. A live Alexa+ connection needs Amazon's developer access, which is not part of this build.

ring.title: Ring front door
ring.intro: Hearth can use {{name}}'s Ring doorbell as a presence source: movement at the door and doors opening, with a time. It never requests video, pictures or live view, and it ignores vehicles, deliveries and the doorbell button (that is a visitor).
ring.tokenPlaceholder: Paste a token from the Ring Developer Playground
ring.playground: This is a Developer Playground token (its events are marked simulated)
ring.result: Imported {{imported}} new events ({{seen}} read from {{devices}} devices).
ring.privacy: The token is used for this import only and is not stored. Each import is written to the Trust Ledger.

kiosk.openHint: Messages, visits and what your family sees
kiosk.title: Family and sharing
kiosk.delegateTitle: Who can change this for me
kiosk.delegateHint: This person can change your sharing for you. Your family cannot change it otherwise.
kiosk.awayHint: Your family will see that you are away, so no one worries about a quiet house.
kiosk.awayNow: You are marked as away until {{date}}.
kiosk.honestHelp: This tells your family in the Hearth app. It is not an emergency service: in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

ask.title: Ask Hearth
suggestions: Who is covering the errands this week?
ask.privacy: Hearth's assistant only sees what {{name}} shares, can't change anything, and your question is not stored.
ask.error: Hearth could not answer right now. Try again in a moment.

home.subtitle: Your family's care, in one calm place.
home.planHint: Find a time that works for everyone
home.controlBody: She decides what to share, with whom, and for how long. Every look is in the Trust Ledger.
